description: C# course exercises from SeeSharp: instructions, workspace and grading inside VS Code.
config.cliPath: Path to a SeeSharp checkout (or its `src/SeeSharp.Cli` project). When set, *Start SeeSharp* runs `dotnet run --project` on it instead of the installed `seesharp` tool.
welcome.setup: First time here? *Set up SeeSharp* installs the tool, clones the course and starts it.
welcome.noCourse: SeeSharp is running, but no course is set up yet.
config.extraPackageSource: Extra NuGet source (a folder with `SeeSharp.Cli.*.nupkg` or a feed URL) for *Set up SeeSharp*, passed to `dotnet tool install` as `--add-source`. Empty = nuget.org only.
